title: Animal Tissues
cheat_card: Epithelial Tissue: Forms continuous sheets lining body cavities, anchored to a basement membrane. Classifed as simple (one layer: squamous, cuboidal, columnar) or stratified, joined by tight, adhesion, or gap junctions.

Connective Tissue: Consists of specialized cells in a noncellular ground substance with protein fibers (collagen, reticular, elastic). Categories: fibrous (loose, adipose, dense in tendons/ligaments), supportive (cartilage in lacunae; bone in lacunae within concentric circles of osteons around central canals), and fluid (blood, lymph).

Muscular Tissue: Contractile fibers containing actin and myosin. Skeletal is voluntary and striated; smooth is involuntary and non-striated; cardiac is striated, involuntary, and joined by intercalated disks.
Nervous Tissue: Conducts electrical impulses. Contains neurons (cell body, dendrites, axon) and supporting neuroglia (microglia, astrocytes, oligodendrocytes).
memory_anchor:
Four Animal Tissue Types Overview

  • Epithelial: Protection & Lining (Connected to basement membrane; simple/stratified squamous, cuboidal, columnar).
  • Connective: Support & Transport (Cells in ground matrix; fibrous, supportive [cartilage/bone], fluid [blood/lymph]).
  • Muscular: Movement (Contractile actin/myosin; skeletal [striated, voluntary], smooth [non-striated, involuntary], cardiac [striated, intercalated disks]).
  • Nervous: Communication (Impulse conduction; neurons and supporting glial cells [neuroglia]).

flashcards.q: Contrast simple squamous, simple cuboidal, and simple columnar epithelial tissues.
flashcards.a: All three are single layers of cells touching the basement membrane. Simple squamous epithelia consist of flattened cells optimized for diffusion; simple cuboidal epithelia have cube-shaped cells optimized for secretion/absorption; simple columnar epithelia have tall, column-shaped cells optimized for absorption and lining the digestive tract.

flashcards.q: Describe the microanatomy of compact bone tissue.
flashcards.a: Compact bone contains structural units called osteons. Within each osteon, inorganic calcium salts and protein fibers are deposited in concentric circles around a central canal (which contains blood vessels). Mature bone cells (osteocytes) reside within small chambers called lacunae.

flashcards.q: Compare skeletal, smooth, and cardiac muscular tissues structurally and functionally.
flashcards.a: Skeletal muscle is voluntary, striated, and composed of long, multinucleated fibers. Smooth muscle is involuntary, spindle-shaped, and lacks striations. Cardiac muscle is striated but involuntary, consists of branching cells bound by intercalated disks, and contracts rhythmically via pacemaker cells.

outline_blanks: Animal organs are composed of four tissue types. Epithelial tissue is anchored to a [[basement membrane]], supportive connective tissue includes bone organized into [[osteons]], and muscular tissue contains contractile [[actin and myosin]] filaments. Nervous tissue consists of conducting cells called [[neurons]] and supporting cells called [[neuroglia]].
